p1: Part 1 of 2. New episode: God's Best Gift (Christmas is about Jesus). Make 12 separate wide 16:9 images, same soft 3D style, warm light and same Eliora characters as before, gentle and child-friendly, no text. Setting: Bethlehem at night with warm lantern light, a cozy simple stable with hay and a wooden manger, a donkey, a cow and a few sheep, quiet starry hills. Mary: a gentle young woman with a soft blue head covering over a cream dress. Joseph: a kind young man with short dark hair and a short dark beard in a brown robe. Baby Jesus: a sweet sleeping baby wrapped in cream cloths with a soft warm glow, always gentle and peaceful. The shepherds: three friendly shepherds of different ages and skin tones in brown and green robes. The angel: a radiant kind angel in white with a golden glow, never scary. The wise men: three kind men in rich colorful robes riding camels, with gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh. The world: happy children of many skin tones around the world. IMPORTANT: porch scenes use Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli and Pip in exactly their reference-sheet outfits (mustard cardigan and round gold glasses; green dress with yellow ribbons; red-white striped T-shirt and blue shorts; lamb with gold bell on blue ribbon). Story scenes must NOT include Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli or Pip, and no grey-bearded old man in story scenes. 1) Grandpa Sol's porch with Zara and Eli wrapping presents with ribbon, Pip the lamb sitting on a ribbon, a little nativity set on a table, Grandpa Sol smiling. 2) Close-up of Eli holding a wrapped present with a big smile, Zara beside him, the little nativity set glowing behind them. 3) Grandpa Sol, Zara, Eli and Pip cozy together on the porch bench with a blanket, Eli looking curious, warm light. 4) A big beautifully wrapped present with a golden ribbon glowing softly on a table, hands reaching toward it, warm light. 5) A starry night sky over the little town of Bethlehem with one bright star, peaceful and warm. 6) The cozy stable glowing with lantern light, hay and a wooden manger, a donkey and a cow resting. 7) Baby Jesus asleep in the wooden manger with a soft golden glow, Mary smiling beside Him, Joseph near. 8) A close-up of baby Jesus' peaceful sleeping face in the manger, soft warm glow, bits of hay. 9) A beautiful golden light spreading from the manger into the night sky and over the world, gentle and bright. 10) The whole round world glowing softly like a gift with a golden ribbon, surrounded by stars, in soft 3D cartoon style. 11) Children of many skin tones around the world looking up with happy faces toward a soft golden star. 12) The kind angel in white with a golden glow telling the shepherds good news on a starry hill, sheep around. Create all 12 as separate cartoon images in the same soft 3D style (not realistic).

t: Make one wide 16:9 title image in the same soft 3D style as the story: Grandpa Sol's cozy porch at dusk with soft twinkle lights and a little nativity set glowing on a table, Zara, Eli and Pip smiling and holding a wrapped present with a golden ribbon while Grandpa Sol smiles. In the foreground, a big carved wooden sign lettered exactly "GOD'S BEST GIFT" in big clear capital letters, and below it a cream ribbon banner lettered exactly "CHRISTMAS IS ABOUT JESUS". No other text, no watermark. Place the sign and ribbon so they do not cover any character's head or face. Use a warm palette of gold, deep red, cream and soft green, with the same reference-sheet outfits as before.
